      "snippet": "Best parking for ICE! at the Gaylord Texan

Gaylord Texan Resort & Convention Center

Recommendation: Day Visitor – Resort Garage ($23 prepaid)

Why this is the best choice

Closest access to the ICE! attraction and hotel interior routes.

Covered parking, which matters after exiting ICE! (cold → warm).

Shortest walk, helpful with kids, strollers, or bulky winter gear.

Direct indoor navigation once inside the resort.

Alternatives (when they make sense)
